title: ononis reclinata var. inclusa
intro: Ononis reclinata var. inclusa, commonly known as Sickle-leaved Restharrow, is a plant species belonging to the legume family (Fabaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ononis reclinata var. inclusa include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, and the management of gastrointestinal disorders and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its composition and potential applications.
